parsing_notes: Report has 53 numbered finding sections under '## Detailed findings': headings 1-50 plus a combined '### 51-53. Unverified crafted-input issues' section (three bullets: 51 BssDecoder, 52 DbpDecoder, 53 strptime, each with its own file:line cites, parsed individually for region matching), plus 54 and 55. A separate '### Additional low-severity observations' section is NOT a numbered finding and was excluded from all matching (its cites: src/function/table/range.cpp, bitwise.cpp:281, filter_combiner.cpp, bound_window_expression.cpp:96).

Primary location definition used: the first line-bearing citation whose file is named on the finding's **File:**/**Files:** line; for the heading-less 51-53 section, the first line-bearing citation in the section (column_reader.cpp:446-450). Findings 2 and 17 name no line on the File: line, so their primary comes from the first body 'Lines N-M' reference (list_resize.cpp:36-42; move_constants.cpp:43-45), which matches the report's own summary-table File:line column.

Findings with NO line number anywhere for their primary file cannot strict-match: finding 23 (make_date.cpp, no line cited) and finding 24 (cast_operators.cpp '(DecimalCastOperation)', no line; its body does cite cast_helpers.hpp:141, counted for region matching only). Finding 10's File line names alp_scan.hpp without a line, so primary falls to alprd_scan.hpp:186-192. Finding 52 (parquet_dbp_decoder.hpp) cites no line at all.

Filename resolution: bare filenames and partial paths in the report were resolved against the repo tree at /tmp/cbh-run/duckdb (e.g. 'concat.cpp' -> src/function/scalar/string/concat.cpp, 'hugeint.cpp' -> src/common/types/hugeint.cpp, 'alprd/alprd_scan.hpp' -> src/include/duckdb/storage/compression/alprd/...). No filename was ambiguous. Four illustrative non-existent paths in finding 36's body (a/b.c, b.c) were unresolved and carry no line numbers, so they cannot affect matching.

Time-of-day-like tokens (e.g. '00:00:00', '+01:30' in SQL repro output) were masked before parsing so they are not mistaken for ':line' citations; ranges were never widened, only exact enumeration of cited N, N-M, and comma-separated lists (e.g. window_executor.cpp:1460-1463, 1496-1499, 1533-1536).

The report was produced at commit 20b1486d11 (v0.10.0 dev, Feb 2024) while the ground-truth JSON records upstream_commit 9f7399e15e6172900e0591deb5a57a45769d8205 with base_ref v0.10.0; matching used exact line membership in the JSON's removed sets with no tolerance, as instructed.

All 6 region matches were spot-checked against the repo sources: rle.cpp:60,64 (flush on differing values), list_casts.cpp:211 (child fast-path copy), bound_cast_expression.cpp:152-161 and :154-155 (VARCHAR->TIMESTAMP invertible switch), printf.cpp:108-129 (format_args type switch), in_clause_simplification_rule.cpp:26,28 (CastIsInvertible guard). Each sits on the code the finding describes, so the matches are semantically correct, not accidental numeric collisions.

Near misses NOT counted (exact membership only, as instructed): finding 33 cites like.cpp:38 (the UNDERSCORE branch in the report's tree) while bug duckdb-350ed10c5eea removes like.cpp:39, one line off; finding 31 cites bitwise.cpp:229 (max_value/overflow check) while bug duckdb-86fe04caf9f4 removes bitwise.cpp:209,213 in the same left-shift operator, a few lines off; finding 51-53 (bullet 53) cites strftime_format.cpp:756-805 and finding 48 cites :39-40,266 while bug duckdb-b219521ef1e5 removes only :1188-1189; findings 8/45 cite array_column_data.cpp:168/:121 while duckdb-863b896717f1 removes :117; finding 12 cites window_segment_tree.cpp:354-370 while duckdb-de68e49f3522 removes :619; findings 24/42 cite cast_operators.cpp (no line)/:1141-1180 while duckdb-675eb44147c9 removes :2388; finding 14 cites physical_streaming_window.cpp (no line) while duckdb-8450ad72d657 removes :170-171; finding 16 cites propagate_cast.cpp:24-37 while duckdb-55543d201747 removes :125; finding 39 cites date_diff.cpp:109 while duckdb-b16e2dce4c66 removes :205-222. Some of these gaps look like small line drift between the report's commit (20b1486d11) and the benchmark base commit (9f7399e15e), but per instructions they are not counted and no range was widened.

17 of the 109 bugs' hunk files are cited by at least one finding at file level; the other 92 bug files (catalog, parser, join-order, JSON/ICU/excel/tpch/tpcds extensions, etc.) are never cited by any finding, consistent with the report's chosen review areas (window, casts, storage/compression, string/list functions, parquet, CSV).
